scope.coverageStatement: Complete currently published Cobb November 3, 2026 county consolidated sample fields and all 242 assigned style-precinct samples (226 of 231 public catalog styles) reviewed. Five catalog entries have no published precinct assignment and public style-only sample requests return 404, so full style coverage is not claimed. Eight distinct complete named local fields, twelve printed people and 930 repeated local block observations. One catalog style contains two federal fields only; no reader absence inferred.
scope.sourceOmissions: Five unassigned catalog styles could not be rendered by the public style-only sample GET route; exact 404 responses are retained. Current consolidated county candidate fields and every precinct-assigned sample are reviewed. No separate unpublished or off-cycle city ballot, earlier May judicial slate, cancellation notice or unlisted local write-in candidate is inferred.
scope.measures: All native question text retained for evidence, including Cobb SPLOST and Mableton redevelopment question; no question fact or explainer is added or changed.
